correctness.rationale: Exact rational arithmetic on the source's displayed A and P gives max standard-CARE residual 1789/2000000 and max printed-sign residual 5532161073/25000000. The argument does not infer unprinted simulation details.

value.rationale: The sign is implementation-critical rather than cosmetic: the displayed positive gain produces a Hurwitz error matrix, while following the printed negative gain literally produces an open-right-half-plane matrix. The result tells a reader exactly which convention reproduces the published stabilizing numerical matrix and prevents a controller implementation from reversing stability, while carefully preserving the possibility that the simulations used the correct sign internally.
